The '''Vennoc-x Chronometer''' was a well-designed [[Chronometer/Legends|chronometer]]. It could tell time on a thousand different [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and could be programmed to hold data about new worlds. It came with a timed alarm that could alert the wearer with an audio or vibratory alert. It also included a 4 [[Centimeter/Legends|cm]] square small hidden compartment that could hold a single [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] or [[Datachip/Legends|datachip]].
